title: Senior Product Manager — Generative AI for TV Ads
jd_excerpt:
Roku is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead generative AI and creative products for our advertising business. You will own a portfolio of AI-powered tools that help advertisers create, adapt, and enhance TV ad creative.

The role involves scaling existing AI products, identifying new opportunities, and guiding concepts from discovery to launch. You will partner with engineering, design, ad sales, operations, legal, and marketing to drive adoption, performance, and revenue.
